NBA-IND-at-BKN-1025.summary: Indiana is without T.J. McConnell (hamstring) and Ben Sheppard (torn meniscus), which opens bench guard and wing minutes; Brooklyn rests rookie Mikel Brown Jr.

NBA-LAC-at-OKC-1025.summary: This is an early-season game. Ajay Mitchell is coming off the bench for Oklahoma City (23 minutes and 5 steals vs Denver) in a crowded backcourt with Cason Wallace and Jared McCain. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal and Max Strus, so Darius Garland, Kris Dunn and Rui Hachimura handle the creation.

NBA-TOR-at-MIN-1025.summary: Early-season game with Toronto now featuring Kawhi Leonard alongside Barnes, Barrett and Quickley, and Minnesota fielding Edwards, LaMelo Ball and Kuminga. No fresh injury news beyond Bittle, Ingram and DiVincenzo, who were already out.

NFL-CIN-at-BAL-1025.summary: Lamar Jackson (ankle) was downgraded to out, so Tyler Huntley makes his third straight start; Baltimore's offense managed 13 points against Cleveland and Henry was held to 58 yards with a late fumble. Cincinnati comes off its bye favored by about 3, with a Brown/Perine backfield split that leaned Perine in the last game.

NFL-CLE-at-TEN-1025.summary: The market has turned toward a low-scoring game: the total fell from 40.5 to about 37 and the spread flipped from Titans -2.5 to Browns -2. Calvin Ridley (hip) missed Friday's practice and Tyjae Spears (knee) is questionable; Denzel Ward has a new hand injury, which could thin Cleveland's man coverage.

NFL-DAL-at-PHI-1027.summary: Philadelphia starts Tanner McKee (Hurts out with blood clots) without WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks, slot CB Michael Carter II or edge Nolan Smith, and Greenard is a game-time call; Dallas is a 4.5-point road favorite. Saquon Barkley practiced fully Saturday and is trending toward returning.

NFL-DEN-at-ARI-1025.summary: Arizona is without RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) again, so Tyler Allgeier and Bam Knight split the backfield as they did in Week 6 (18 and 15 carries). Jacoby Brissett starts at QB, with Carson Beck (back) questionable as the No. 3. Denver's Pat Surtain II returned to practice as a limited participant and is questionable; Denver is a 4.5-point road favorite in a dome.

NFL-GB-at-DET-1025.summary: Detroit comes off its bye as a 3-3.5 point home favorite with a 55.5 total, getting C Cade Mays and S Brian Branch back. Green Bay is without Micah Parsons and LB Zaire Franklin, though its defense has allowed only 1.10 points per drive over the last three weeks. Isiah Pacheco is on IR, leaving Gibbs as Detroit's clear lead back.

NFL-IND-at-MIN-1025.summary: Minnesota, off its bye, is a 6-6.5 point home favorite and the total has dropped from 42.5 to 41.5. Jordan Mason practiced fully all week off IR (questionable pending activation), which threatens Aaron Jones' recent bell-cow volume. Indianapolis is without TE Tyler Warren and CB Sauce Gardner and faces a Vikings front allowing under 90 rushing yards a game.

NFL-KC-at-SEA-1026.summary: Seattle is missing linebackers Drake Thomas and Chazz Surratt and has three more front-seven players questionable, which helps Kansas City's run game with Kenneth Walker III. Kansas City is without Rashee Rice again, and CB L'Jarius Sneed did not travel for personal reasons. Seattle uses Emanuel Wilson as RB1 with Zach Charbonnet out (ACL); rain chances near 40% with light wind.

NFL-LA-at-LV-1025.summary: Puka Nacua (calf) is a game-time decision after leaving Thursday's practice and sitting Friday, and Davante Adams is out for weeks with a hamstring tear, so the Rams' receiver room is thin. Raiders RB2 Mike Washington (foot) missed Thursday and Friday and looks unlikely, which concentrates backfield work on Ashton Jeanty; Brock Bowers practiced fully.

NFL-MIA-at-NYJ-1025.summary: Breece Hall (quad) is questionable after missing three games; he was limited Thursday and Friday and Glenn will decide Sunday, with Braelon Allen still getting carries either way. Adonai Mitchell returns from finger surgery, so the Jets have Wilson, Mitchell and Cooper together for the first time since Week 1. Miami's Malik Willis practiced fully (thumb); weather is mild with light wind.

NFL-NYG-at-HOU-1025.summary: J.J. McCarthy makes his first start for the Giants (Dart out for the season) as a 10-10.5 point road dog; Houston is missing both starting safeties (Pitre, Blankenship) and RT Blake Fisher. Houston's backfield has consolidated behind Woody Marks with Montgomery out and Jawhar Jordan on the practice-squad IR, while the Giants released Najee Harris and Tyrone Tracy led their backfield last week.

NFL-PIT-at-NO-1025.summary: Saints home game in Paris with Pittsburgh a 3-3.5 point favorite. Rodgers has been dropping back at a top-5 rate on very short throws, while Shough is coming off a 53% passing day behind an offensive line that may start a rookie at center. Travis Etienne remains on IR, so New Orleans' backfield is Kendre Miller, Kamara (limited Friday, back) and CJ Donaldson.

NFL-SF-at-ATL-1025.summary: San Francisco is without Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel at receiver and Nick Bosa plus two linebackers on defense; Christian Kirk is back from IR. Atlanta loses Brian Robinson (hamstring), with Khalil Herbert elevated as the RB2, which explains Bijan's yardage line rising from 113.5 to 125.5.

NFL-TB-at-CAR-1025.summary: Baker Mayfield returns from a dislocated right thumb after missing three games, practicing in full Friday while wearing a glove on his throwing hand. Tampa Bay is without WR Emeka Egbuka, RT Luke Goedeke and S Antoine Winfield Jr., which pushes Tez Johnson into a bigger role. Carolina is about a 3-point home favorite, the total slipped from 45.5 to 44.5, and Chuba Hubbard handled 28 carries in Week 6.

fix.summary: Quality-gate checks on Top 10 picks that had no research note.

NBA-HOU-at-ATL-1025.summary: Atlanta opened with a 132-125 win at Orlando and is without backup bigs Mouhamed Gueye (foot) and Henri Veesaar (knee), which leaves more center minutes for Onyeka Okongwu. Houston beat San Antonio 114-110 Friday, with Sengun (29-7) and Amen Thompson (20-10) carrying the load.

NBA-SA-at-DAL-1025.summary: Both teams are on the second night of a back-to-back. Dallas is without Cooper Flagg (left shoulder, hurt Friday at Indiana), Lively, Aldama and Biberovic, but Kyrie Irving is active and starting (not in the app's starter list), so the ball runs through him. Spurs lose Tobias Harris (calf).

best.why: Brian Robinson (hamstring) is out and only practice-squad elevation Khalil Herbert backs Bijan up, so his touch share should be near total. San Francisco has ruled out Nick Bosa and two linebackers, and the game is in a dome. Books post 120.5 to 124.5, below the app's 125.5, so the over is easier at the posted number.
